```yaml
name: Test Meshery UI Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  integration-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install Sistent dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Sistent tarball
        run: npm pack
        id: pack

      - name: Set tarball name
        run: echo "TARBALL=$(ls *.tgz)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        id: set_tarball

      - name: Checkout Meshery UI
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: meshery/meshery
          path: meshery
          ref: main

      - name: Setup Node.js 20 for Meshery
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: meshery/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Meshery dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Verify Meshery test script exists
        run: |
          if ! grep -E '"test"\s*:' meshery/package.json; then
            echo "❌ No test script found in Meshery package.json"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Sistent into Meshery
        run: npm install ${{ env.TARBALL }}
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Build Meshery UI
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Run Meshery UI tests
        run: npm test
        working-directory: meshery
        continue-on-error: true
        id: test

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        if: always()
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            const outcome = '${{ steps.test.outcome }}';
            const comment = outcome === 'success'
              ? '✅ Meshery UI integration tests passed.'
              : '❌ Meshery UI integration tests failed.';
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: comment
            });
```
